title: SAG2: Embedding-Free Multi-Hop Retrieval with BM25 and JEV
abstract: arXiv:2610.22588v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Strong multi-hop retrieval should be practical to deploy without expensive corpus preparation or complex database infrastructure. We present SAG2, an embedding-free retrieval architecture built around a single SQLite database, BM25, and contextual evidence decisions from JEV. SAG2 follows the query-time association principle of SAG (SQL-Retrieval Augmented Generation), while replacing its event-entity and dense indexes with a lexical index over original passages. Selected passages supply terms for further retrieval, and newly retrieved evidence guides subsequent decisions. This moves semantic evidence selection to query time, eliminating offline embedding computation, LLM-based event-entity extraction, and dedicated database servers. The resulting system combines lightweight preparation with strong retrieval accuracy: on 1,000-question subsets of MuSiQue, 2WikiMultiHopQA, and HotpotQA, SAG2 achieves the highest Recall@5 and Recall@10 amo

translated_title: SAG2：基于BM25与JEV的无嵌入多跳检索
translated_abstract: 强大的多跳检索系统应当在实际部署中无需昂贵的语料库准备或复杂的数据库基础设施。我们提出了SAG2，一种无嵌入的检索架构，它围绕单个SQLite数据库、BM25以及来自JEV的上下文证据决策构建。SAG2遵循SAG（SQL-Retrieval Augmented Generation，SQL检索增强生成）的查询时关联原则，同时用针对原始文本段的词法索引取代了其事件-实体索引和稠密向量索引。被选中的文本段为后续检索提供查询词，而新检索到的证据则指导后续决策。这将语义证据选择转移到了查询时进行，从而省去了离线嵌入计算、基于大语言模型的事件-实体抽取以及专用数据库服务器。由此得到的系统兼具轻量级的准备工作与强大的检索准确率：在MuSiQue、2WikiMultiHopQA和HotpotQA各1000个问题的子集上，SAG2取得了最高的Recall@5和Recall@10……
tldr: SAG2提出了一种无需嵌入向量的多跳检索架构，仅依靠单个SQLite数据库、BM25词法索引和JEV上下文证据决策，在查询时完成语义证据选择，同时实现了轻量级部署准备和多个多跳问答基准上最高的检索召回率。
en_tdlr: SAG2 is an embedding-free multi-hop retrieval architecture that uses only a single SQLite database, BM25 lexical indexing, and JEV-based contextual evidence decisions to perform semantic evidence selection at query time, achieving top retrieval recall with lightweight deployment.
